topic: Adiponectin: fat-derived hormone boosting insulin sensitivity
caption: Did you know your fat cells can help regulate blood sugar? 🌟 Adiponectin, a hormone produced by fat tissue, boosts insulin sensitivity. 💡 Here are the facts: Adiponectin levels decrease with obesity and increase with weight loss. 🏋️‍♀️ It also has anti-inflammatory properties. 🌿 Save this so you don't lose it.
